Rahul Gandhi questions Amit Shah on police action during student protest

Congress leader Rahul Gandhi wrote to Union Home Minister Amit Shah regarding the police action during a student protest in Delhi on July 20. Gandhi questioned who authorized the use of pellet guns and tear gas against the students. He demanded accountability for the actions of security forces during the demonstration at Jantar Mantar. Opposition parties plan to raise the issue in Parliament.
